description: Electrically meaningful power system test case diagrams (Texas A&M Electric Grid Test Cases) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Paul Cuffe. These images show simple test system diagrams for three of the test power systems in the Texas A&M " Electric Grid Test Cases " collection (see https://electricgrids.engr.tamu.edu/ and A.B. Birchfield, T. Xu, K.M. Gegner, K.S. Shetye, T.J. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1011312 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
